items.title: US-Iran war highlights vulnerability of Mideast undersea cables
US launches ninth night of strikes on Iran as it hits out at Gulf neighbors
items.description: Early on Monday, Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they had launched a 'surprise attack' on an 'enemy command center' in Syria. This fresh round of violence comes after three new US military fatalities were announced, as hope for a political settlement to end the war has dimmed.

items.title: US soldier killed in Iraq during ‘controlled detonation’ of Iranian drone
items.description: The death brings the number of US soldiers killed since the start of the US-Israel war on Iran to 17.

items.title: US announces death of another service member, Jordan summons Iranian envoy over attacks
items.description: A US service member died during a "controlled detonation" of unexploded ordnance from a downed Iranian drone in northern Iraq, the military said Sunday. items.title: US soldier killed and one injured after Iranian attack in Iraq
items.description: The US military reports another death a day after two of its soldiers were killed in Jordan.

items.title: Marina ucraina, missili russi su una nave mercantile turca, 5 morti
items.description: 'Stava lasciando la zona di guerra' nel Mar Nero. Si contano anche 5 dispersi e 8 feriti

items.title: Russia Hits Kyiv In Massive Missile And Drone Attack
items.description: Russia launched 41 missiles and 125 drones in a massive overnight attack on Ukraine, with Kyiv as the main target. Ukrainian officials said it was Russia's largest use of ballistic missiles since the start of the full-scale invasion. At least one person was killed and 16 were injured.

items.title: Russian Strike on Kharkiv Suburbs Kills Three, Injures 20
items.description: Russian forces attacked the suburbs of Kharkiv on Sunday, July 19, resulting in three civilian deaths and 20 people injured. items.title: Russia's largest ballistic assault of war rocks Kyiv
items.description: Fires broke out across the Ukrainian capital after Russia's latest missile attack, which used the highest number of ballistic missiles of the war so far. Several people have been injured in Kyiv.

items.title: 8 killed and more than 60 wounded in Ukrainian drone attack on Russian regions
items.description: Kyiv's forces are continuing their aerial campaign against energy infrastructure and military targets inside Russia, aiming to undermine Moscow's war effort.

items.title: Hunger deepens for displaced families in Sudan’s El Obeid
items.description: UN humanitarians working in war-torn Sudan on Friday highlighted rapidly growing needs among the more than 100,000 displaced people now sheltering in camps in the city of El Obeid.

items.title: Pro-Kremlin Blogger Arrested for ‘War Fakes’ Months After Denouncing Putin
items.description: In March, Ilya Remeslo shocked both supporters and critics when he publicly denounced President Vladimir Putin in a scathing manifesto.
